description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Maharagama, Kandy Four Gravets, Rathmalana and Harispattuwa D/S Division for the Water Supply Projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains multiple orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land allotments) for water supply infrastructure projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, their boundaries, locations, and in some cases, the names of claimants. This fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it focuses on land and property-related matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
